description: A metering module that reads the voltage at its input as a number, or names the note that voltage would play

params.text: Turning it clockwise moves to the next mode and anticlockwise to the previous one; while an option is being edited it moves through that option's choices instead. It has no end stops
Each press moves to the next option of the current mode, and a press past the last one returns to metering; the red lamp beside it blinks while an option is being edited
Nothing in the module reads this button; it was put there for a peak-counting mode that has not been written
In the voltmeter's Minimum, Maximum and Median settings, clears the stored readings back to the voltage arriving now

inputs.text: The voltage measured and shown on the display
Nothing in the module reads this jack; it was put there for a peak-counting mode that has not been written
A rising edge above about 1V clears the stored readings, the same clearing the RESET button does

outputs.text: A copy of the input voltage, passed on so the module can be inserted in a line rather than hung off a mult

notes: the display blinks ? Input ? and measures nothing until a cable is patched into the IN jack
the encoder cycles four modes and only two work: Voltmeter and CV Pitch. BPM Meter and Peak Counter scroll a message saying they are unavailable, and Frequency Counter was abandoned
in CV Pitch the display names the note the input voltage would play, from C-1 at -5V up to B9 at 5.917V, with a question mark outside that
in CV Pitch the arrows beside the note name say how far the voltage is from the exact note: two arrows means a long way, one arrow a little way, and no arrow means it has arrived
an option left blinking for 10 seconds without a touch returns to metering on its own
menu: Metering: Realtime, Minimum, Maximum, Median — in Voltmeter mode, whether the reading follows the input, holds the lowest seen, holds the highest seen, or shows the midpoint of the two
Decimals: Auto, 0, 1, 2, 3 — in Voltmeter mode, how many decimal places the reading carries; Auto fits as many as the display has room for
Notation: International (C/D/E.../B), Latin (Do/Ré/Mi.../Si) — in CV Pitch mode, which set of note names the display uses
Sharps/Flats: Sharps (#), Flats (b) — in CV Pitch mode, whether a black note is named as a sharp or as a flat

inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.

outputs.0:
±10V · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
